data.text: CI green on PR #7 (run 36893192488): install x {npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, bun-runtime} x {Linux, macOS, Windows}, 15/15, plus tests on Node 20 and 22. Windows took two fixes, both in the smoke script, not in kadence: npm pack does not create its destination (and the first fix broke the YAML with ': ' in a plain scalar), and Node with shell:true on Windows joins arguments unquoted. kadence itself needed no change to install and run everywhere.
